hypothesis: After an actual liquidation raid, reclaim, refill and MSS, passive mitigation at the raided liquidity level or the 50% sweep leg has superior after-cost expectancy to immediate taker entry, provided fill requires real trade-through and pending orders occupy the global slot.

smc_ict_mapping.external_liquidity_and_confirmation: unchanged causal event definition from CLM-20260726-LIQ-SWEEP-MSS-001
smc_ict_mapping.fill: actual trade-through by 1/2 bp; touch is insufficient
smc_ict_mapping.invalidation: actual sweep extreme plus max(one activation spread, 1 bp)

pending_order_contract.activation: first executable BBO at or after decision plus acknowledgement latency
pending_order_contract.fill: first actual trade penetrating the limit by configured queue bps
pending_order_contract.global_slot: pending order occupies the only global slot until fill or cancellation

position_contract.stop: sweep extreme plus max(one activation spread, 1 bp)
position_contract.exit_execution: adverse of barrier-trigger trade and first post-latency executable BBO

staging.development: only up to twelve complete fit survivors frozen without changes

top_trade_removal: Largest 10% of positive 12-bp event keys are excluded before pending/global-slot routing and the account is rerun from initial NAV.
promotion_boundary: Fatal screen only. A survivor requires unchanged-rule expansion across remaining pre-2024 samples with exact queue reconstruction and funding before 2024 can open.
